flaky.description: Both passed and failed within the window.

flips.description: passed ↔ not-passed changes between consecutive runs

reason.description: Machine-readable classifier: NotFound, BadRequest, Conflict, ManagedByGitOps, Internal, ServiceUnavailable.

config.description: Effective parameters: declared defaults overlaid with the run's overrides.

notBefore.description: Scheduled start (spec.notBefore); the run waits in queued until then.

origin.description: Where the record came from — cluster runs are still mutable via kubectl; archive runs are read-only history.

parentRun.description: Composite parent run name, if any.

details.description: Failure text (stack excerpt), trimmed to 4 KiB.

info.description: Thin REST/WS API the GUI consumes. Reads flow through a controller-runtime shared informer cache; writes go directly to the k8s API server (§CLAUDE.md §7). §7 managed-by policy is enforced here for PATCH/DELETE on Tests; TestRun creation is always allowed regardless of the referenced Test's ownership.
info.title: kubetest-alt API

parameters.description: Target namespace. Required for single-object requests when the server runs cluster-wide; optional (and must match) when it is scoped. On list endpoints, omitting it on a cluster-wide server lists all namespaces.
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.description: Entries with an id lower than this (X-Next-Cursor).
parameters.name: before

get.summary: User actions recorded by this API server, newest first: runs created, aborted, deleted and commented; Tests created, updated, deleted. Actor from X-Kubetest-User. Paging: pass X-Next-Cursor as ?before=.

parameters.description: Filter by source (ui, api, cli, cron, trigger, gitops).
parameters.name: source

parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's X-Next-Cursor.
parameters.name: after

parameters.description: RFC 3339; only runs finished at or after it (excludes live runs).
parameters.name: finishedAfter

X-Next-Cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

get.summary: Live runs first (first page only), then finished runs newest-first by (finishedAt, uid), keyset-paginated: pass X-Next-Cursor back as ?after=. Cluster and archive are merged and deduped by UID (cluster wins).

parameters.description: Target namespace. Required for single-object requests when the server runs cluster-wide; optional (and must match) when it is scoped. On list endpoints, omitting it on a cluster-wide server lists all namespaces.
parameters.name: namespace

post.summary: Create a TestRun. spec.source is set server-side to "ui" — payload override rejected 400. Allowed regardless of the referenced Test's managed-by label (§7 lets GUI trigger runs on gitops-owned Tests).

delete.summary: Delete a finished run from history: its objects (logs, artifacts, result.json), its CR if present, and its store row. 409 while the run is live (abort it first). Idempotent per step; safe to retry.

get.summary: Get a single run by CR name (active) or UID (archived).

parameters.description: Target namespace. Required for single-object requests when the server runs cluster-wide; optional (and must match) when it is scoped. On list endpoints, omitting it on a cluster-wide server lists all namespaces.

parameters.name: namespace

post.summary: Abort a live run. Sets spec.abort (reason User, requestedBy from the X-Kubetest-User header); the controller kills the Job, records the run as aborted, persists it and fires webhooks. Idempotent. Allowed on runs of GitOps-managed Tests (runs are not definitions, §7).

get.summary: List the run's artifacts (recorded refs; falls back to listing the run's artifacts/ prefix when none were recorded).

parameters.description: Target namespace. Required for single-object requests when the server runs cluster-wide; optional (and must match) when it is scoped. On list endpoints, omitting it on a cluster-wide server lists all namespaces.
parameters.name: namespace

get.summary: Stream an artifact's bytes (default; served with nosniff + CSP sandbox, ?download=1 for attachment), or with ?presign=1 return a presigned object-store URL. Path traversal (../, absolute paths, backslashes) rejected 400.

parameters.description: Target namespace. Required for single-object requests when the server runs cluster-wide; optional (and must match) when it is scoped. On list endpoints, omitting it on a cluster-wide server lists all namespaces.
parameters.name: namespace

delete.summary: Remove the comment of a finished run. Idempotent.

parameters.description: Target namespace. Required for single-object requests when the server runs cluster-wide; optional (and must match) when it is scoped. On list endpoints, omitting it on a cluster-wide server lists all namespaces.
parameters.name: namespace

409.description: Run still live, or not in run history yet.

put.summary: Set (replace) the comment of a finished run. The comment lives on the run-history row and is deleted with the run. Author from X-Kubetest-User.

400.description: Namespace missing or outside the server's scope.

404.description: Run not found in the cluster or the archive.

get.summary: Stream logs over WebSocket. Live runs poll object storage chunk prefix every ~1s; archived runs stream all chunks then close. Binary WS frames = raw log bytes.

parameters.description: Target namespace. Required for single-object requests when the server runs cluster-wide; optional (and must match) when it is scoped. On list endpoints, omitting it on a cluster-wide server lists all namespaces.
parameters.name: namespace

get.summary: The run's whole stored log as text/plain (live runs: what has been flushed so far, no follow). ?download=1 adds Content-Disposition: attachment. ?offset=N skips the first N bytes, for clients following a live run.

parameters.description: Target namespace. Required for single-object requests when the server runs cluster-wide; optional (and must match) when it is scoped. On list endpoints, omitting it on a cluster-wide server lists all namespaces.

get.summary: A finished run's JUnit test cases in report order (from run history; empty until the run is persisted or when it reported no JUnit). ?status=failed keeps failed and errored cases.

post.summary: Create a Test. The server sets app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=ui; payloads spoofing any other value are rejected 400.

delete.summary: Delete a Test. Blocked 409 for managed-by!=ui (§7).

patch.summary: JSON merge patch (RFC 7396) of a Test: objects merge, arrays and scalars replace, null deletes. 409 unless managed-by=ui, including when the label is missing (§7); 400 if the patch touches managed-by.

get.summary: The Test merged with its TestTemplates (spec.use), for building run forms: full parameter schema incl. template-only parameters, tool, GitOps lock. Expressions are not evaluated. 422 when a referenced template is missing.
